issue: Transformer delivery forecast is moving toward the need-by date
decision_required: Determine whether to continue supplier recovery or activate mitigation before alternate path disappears
option_b: Reallocate compatible equipment from later site if technically feasible
option_c: Continue supplier recovery and accept additional schedule exposure
schedule_impact: Expedite could recover up to 1 week; reallocation requires validation
cost_impact: Expedite estimate $450K; delay exposure could exceed $1.8M
risk_tradeoff: Reallocation may protect launch but could transfer risk to another site
recommended_action: Validate reallocation feasibility first; if unavailable compare expedite premium against total cost of delay

issue: Engineering change has triggered supplier change order and launch exposure
decision_required: Approve funding and schedule mitigation path for mandatory design change
option_a: Approve change order plus expedite option
option_b: Approve change order only and resequence downstream work
option_c: Challenge scope and hold PO pending review
schedule_impact: Expedite may reduce part of the 3-week impact; resequencing alone may not protect commissioning
cost_impact: Change order $2.0M; expedite option $500K; schedule exposure $4.9M
risk_tradeoff: Holding scope may increase supplier delay if mandatory change is confirmed
recommended_action: Approve mandatory change order and decide expedite based on commissioning exposure

issue: Constrained transformer capacity can support only two of three future needs
decision_required: Allocate constrained supplier capacity across sites using exposure and alternatives
option_a: Reserve slots for Beta and Gamma
option_b: Reserve slots for Gamma and future high-priority site
schedule_impact: Allocation changes critical-path exposure differently by site
risk_tradeoff: Optimizing earliest launch date may miss business priority and alternate-source availability
recommended_action: Prioritize critical-path exposure plus business impact plus lack of alternatives
